diagnosis.summary: Two pods of the `unschedulable` deployment (replicas -rw5pd and -ldzhw) have been stuck in Pending/Unschedulable since 2026-10-04. The scheduler reports 0/3 nodes available: the control-plane node has an untolerated NoSchedule taint, oncall-worker2 carries the `node.kubernetes.io/unschedulable:NoSchedule` taint (cordoned), and oncall-worker has insufficient CPU to satisfy the pod's requests. With all three nodes effectively unavailable for different reasons, no scheduling is possible and preemption cannot help.

hypotheses.title: Pods unschedulable: one worker cordoned, one worker has insufficient CPU, control-plane tainted
hypotheses.mechanism: The cluster has 3 nodes. oncall-control-plane carries the built-in control-plane NoSchedule taint so workload pods cannot land there. oncall-worker2 has been cordoned (unschedulable=True, taint node.kubernetes.io/unschedulable:NoSchedule) since at least 2026-10-04, eliminating it as a candidate. oncall-worker is Ready and schedulable but the scheduler reports 'Insufficient cpu' for it, meaning the pod's CPU request exceeds what remains allocatable on that node. With all three nodes blocked for different reasons, both pending pods cannot be placed and remain Unschedulable indefinitely.
